product_one_liner.value: Cast AI automates Kubernetes workload and infrastructure optimization for organizations running cloud-native and AI workloads, improving cost and performance.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage states it continuously optimizes Kubernetes and the resources beneath it.

pricing_page.notes: Public page offers a custom quote form and describes pricing as environment-specific; it does not publish prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are listed among Cast AI's customer case studies.

hq_location.notes: Company profile identifies Miami, Florida as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: Blog index includes multiple Engineering-tagged infrastructure/technical articles, including posts on Karpenter/Azure, Kubernetes configuration drift, and GPU scheduling.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation has Guides, API Reference, and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers board lists open Senior Applied ML Engineer and Senior ML Engineer roles, among others.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public product documentation and privacy/security-related pages surfaced in research; no specific AI model or model provider was publicly identified.

compliance_certs.notes: Cast AI publicly claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification.

last_funding.notes: A January 2026 company announcement describes a strategic investment round/Series C2 but does not disclose its amount. Amount is represented as 0 because the schema requires a number; the amount itself is undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The strategic investment/Series C2 announcement is dated January 12, 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers board lists multiple Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Kimchi Coding's general availability was announced July 15, 2026, within the six months before the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership appointment announcement found is dated April 17, 2024, outside the 12-month window; no in-window C-level/VP join or departure was found among the small listed leadership team.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Public documentation names a New Relic integration. No CRM system was identified in the reviewed careers/docs/integration material.
